title: DE Community - GitHub Activity
description: Tool growth, activity patterns och PR cycle times i DE-communityt på GitHub

panels.title: DE Tool Growth - Top 10 Repos (Cumulative Stars)
panels.description: Ackumulerade stars per vecka för de 10 mest starred DE-repos i datasetet

targets.rawSql:
WITH top_repos AS (
  SELECT repo_name
  FROM tool_growth
  GROUP BY repo_name
  ORDER BY MAX(CAST(cumulative_stars AS BIGINT)) DESC
  LIMIT 10
)
SELECT
  t.week_start AS time,
  t.repo_name,
  CAST(t.cumulative_stars AS BIGINT) AS cumulative_stars
FROM tool_growth t
INNER JOIN top_repos r ON t.repo_name = r.repo_name
ORDER BY t.week_start ASC, t.repo_name ASC

panels.title: Community Activity Heatmap - Hour × Weekday
panels.description: När är DE-communityt aktivt? Mörkare färg = fler events. Spark dayofweek: 1=Sunday, 7=Saturday.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  hour_of_day,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN day_of_week = 1 THEN event_count ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS "1_Mon",
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN day_of_week = 2 THEN event_count ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS "2_Tue",
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN day_of_week = 3 THEN event_count ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS "3_Wed",
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN day_of_week = 4 THEN event_count ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS "4_Thu",
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN day_of_week = 5 THEN event_count ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS "5_Fri",
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN day_of_week = 6 THEN event_count ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS "6_Sat",
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN day_of_week = 7 THEN event_count ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS "7_Sun"
FROM activity_heatmap
GROUP BY hour_of_day
ORDER BY hour_of_day ASC

panels.title: PR Cycle Times - Median & P95 (timmar)
panels.description: Repos med längst PR-cykel. Grön = median (typisk cykel), Gul = p95 (de 5% långsammaste PRs - stora features, blockerade reviews).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  repo_name,
  CAST(median_hours AS DOUBLE) AS median_hours,
  CAST(p95_hours AS DOUBLE) AS p95_hours
FROM pr_cycle_times
WHERE median_hours > 0
ORDER BY median_hours DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Bot vs Human Activity - andel av veckans events
panels.description: Andel av all DE-community-aktivitet per aktörskategori och vecka. 'Bot' = hög konfidens (GitHubs [bot]-mekanism + etablerade namnkonventioner). 'Suspected automation' = provisorisk beteendeheuristik (volym+diversitet, tröskel 500), lägre konfidens - medvetet EJ hopslagen med 'Bot'. 'Unknown' är menat som en tripwire: den kan bara få rader vid NULL actor_login. Pågaende vecka är exkluderad (ofullständig veckodagssammansättning).

targets.rawSql:
WITH weekly AS (
    -- Steg 1: kollapsa event_type. event_count ar DISTRIBUTIVT -> far summeras vidare.
    SELECT
        week_start,
        actor_category,
        SUM(event_count) AS events
    FROM bot_vs_human_activity
    WHERE week_start < date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE)  -- exkludera pagaende vecka
    GROUP BY week_start, actor_category
),
shares AS (
    -- Steg 2: rakna om andelen pa den NYA grainen. Aldrig AVG pa en befintlig pct.
    SELECT
        week_start,
        actor_category,
        100.0 * events / SUM(events) OVER (PARTITION BY week_start) AS pct
    FROM weekly
)
-- Steg 3: pivotera. KOLUMNORDNINGEN = stackordningen i Grafana.
SELECT
    week_start AS time,
    CAST(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN actor_category = 'bot'                  THEN pct END), 2) AS DOUBLE) AS "Bot",
    CAST(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN actor_category = 'suspected_automation' THEN pct END), 2) AS DOUBLE) AS "Suspected automation",
    CAST(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN actor_category = 'human'                THEN pct END), 2) AS DOUBLE) AS "Human",
    CAST(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN actor_category = 'unknown'              THEN pct END), 2) AS DOUBLE) AS "Unknown"
FROM shares
GROUP BY week_start
ORDER BY week_start ASC
